mapper.sql: a.uuid, a.title, a.content, a.status, a.publisher_id, u.nickname AS publisher_name, a.publish_time, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT uuid, title, publish_time FROM sys_announcement WHERE status = 1 AND publish_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY publish_time DESC, uuid DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM sys_announcement a
INNER JOIN sys_announcement anchor ON anchor.uuid = #{query.cursorId} AND anchor.publish_time IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.uuid = a.publisher_id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.publish_time IS NOT NULL
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%')
AND (a.publish_time > anchor.publish_time OR (a.publish_time = anchor.publish_time AND a.uuid > anchor.uuid))
AND (a.publish_time < anchor.publish_time OR (a.publish_time = anchor.publish_time AND a.uuid < anchor.uuid))
ORDER BY a.publish_time ASC, a.uuid ASC ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC, a.uuid DESC
LIMIT #{limitPlusOne}

SELECT FROM sys_announcement a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.uuid = a.publisher_id
a.status = #{query.status}
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%')
ORDER BY (a.publish_time IS NULL) ASC,
a.publish_time ASC, a.publish_time DESC,
a.create_time ASC, a.create_time DESC,
a.update_time ASC, a.update_time DESC,
a.uuid ASC a.uuid DESC
SELECT a.uuid, a.title, a.content, a.status, a.publisher_id, a.publish_time, a.create_user_id, a.update_user_id, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM sys_announcement a WHERE a.uuid = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_announcement (uuid, title, content, status, publisher_id, publish_time, create_user_id, update_user_id) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, NULL, NULL, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_announcement SET update_time = NOW(), update_user_id = #{operatorId} WHERE uuid = #{id} AND status = 0
